steps.label: prep
steps.run: mkdir -p "$AGENT_HOME/work/ship2" && cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/ship2" && cp "$AGENT_HOME/repo/packs/ship/"* . && rm -f st_*.jpg; cp -n "$AGENT_HOME"/work/ship/*.blend . 2>/dev/null; true

steps.label: stills
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/ship2" && for s in sea_track port stern_prop holo_dive; do /usr/bin/time -p /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P ship3d.py -- $s still 50 > st_$s.log 2>&1; grep -a -E "SHIP3D|^real" st_$s.log | cut -c1-400 > info_$s.txt; tail -2 st_$s.log >> info_$s.txt; done; a=""; for f in st_*.jpg info_*.txt; do a="$a $f ship/st3/$f"; done; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" $a | tail -2

steps.label: r_sea_track
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/ship2" && for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do RTAG=_f /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P ship3d.py -- sea_track render 50 >> r_sea_track.log 2>&1; grep -a "SHIP3D RENDERED" r_sea_track.log >/dev/null && break; sleep 3; done; ls r_sea_track_f | wc -l; grep -a "SHIP3D" r_sea_track.log | tail -2 > info_r_sea_track.txt; cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -framerate 25 -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/ship2/r_sea_track_f/f%04d.jpg" -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 17 -pix_fmt yuv420p "$AGENT_HOME/work/ship2/sea_track.mp4"; cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/ship2" && ls -l sea_track.mp4; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" sea_track.mp4 ship/r3d/sea_track.mp4 info_r_sea_track.txt ship/r3d/info_sea_track.txt | tail -1
